Kuvitus: jokilaakso kesäpäivänä. Keskell: Illustration: a river valley on a summer day. In the middle, a hydropower plant has been built across the river: behind the dam the upper water is high, and below the plant the water leaving it foams white at a lower level. In the background, four wind turbines turn on a ridge, and lines in the sky show the wind. A power line with pylons leads away from the plant.
Periaatekuva vesivoimalasta poikkileikka: Schematic cross-section of a hydropower plant, not to scale. On the left, behind the dam, is the upper reservoir with its surface high up. Water flows down a pipe through the dam to a turbine, which turns a generator through a shaft. After the turbine the water is discharged to the right into the tailwater. The difference in height between the upper and lower water surfaces is the head h. The potential energy of the water turns into kinetic energy in the pipe, into energy of rotation in the turbine and into electricity in the generator, shown by the orange arrow.
Periaatekuva, ei mittakaavassa: tuuli pu: Schematic, not to scale: the wind blows from the left towards the rotor of a wind turbine. In time t the air flowing through the rotor fills a cylinder. The cross-sectional area of the cylinder is the area swept by the rotor, A = πr², and its length is s = vt, so the mass of the air is m = ρAvt. The blue arrow is the wind speed v.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa, valmistajan ilmoi: Graph to scale, the power curve given by the manufacturer: the electric power P of a wind turbine in kilowatts as a function of the wind speed v, for a rotor diameter of 82 m. Points: 3 m/s 0 kW, 4 m/s 28 kW, 5 m/s 144 kW, 6 m/s 309 kW, 7 m/s 511 kW, 8 m/s 758 kW, 9 m/s 1017 kW, 10 m/s 1285 kW, 11 m/s 1504 kW, 12 m/s 1637 kW and 13–20 m/s 1650 kW. The dashed line is the model curve ½ηρAv³ for η = 0.45: it rises like the points but keeps rising when the points level off at 1650 kilowatts.

Graph to scale, the power curve given by the manufacturer: the electric power P of a wind turbine in kilowatts as a function of the wind speed v, for a rotor diameter of 82 m. Points: 3 m/s 0 kW, 4 m/s 28 kW, 5 m/s 144 kW, 6 m/s 309 kW, 7 m/s 511 kW, 8 m/s 758 kW, 9 m/s 1017 kW, 10 m/s 1285 kW, 11 m/s 1504 kW, 12 m/s 1637 kW and 13–20 m/s 1650 kW. There is no curve between the points.
